title: Probably Up to Date — Libraries That Agree in the End
description: Probabilistically Bounded Staleness told on the scholars' coast of Paxos: an entry of the compendium answered for by three home libraries, a writer who waits for some of them, a reader who asks a few, and the odds that the copy handed over is the newest.
question: When a store reads from only some of its copies, how likely is an answer to be out of date, and by how much? Can we promise that it is probably not?
how: We find out by exploring how the libraries of the scholars' coast, each entry answered for by three of them, worked out the odds that a reader who asks only a few is handed the newest version.

papers.authors: Peter Bailis, Shivaram Venkataraman, Michael J. Franklin, Joseph M. Hellerstein and Ion Stoica
papers.title: Probabilistically Bounded Staleness for Practical Partial Quorums
